examples.arabic: "بالزبط، هو قدامك بعد لفتين صغار، بس انتبهي فيه بسطة عصير جلاب تناثرت حواليها كاسات."
examples.english: "Exactly, it's in front of you after two small turns, but pay attention, there's a jallab juice stand with scattered cups around it."
examples.transliteration: "Bilzabt, huwwa 'uddamak ba'd laftayn zghar, bas intibhi feeh bastet 'aseer jallab tanatharat hawaliha kasat."
examples.storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

examples.arabic: النادلة ابتسمت واقترحت: "ليه ما بتجربي صحن فلافل مع عصير برتقال فريش؟ هو كتير طيب اليوم."
examples.english: The waitress smiled and suggested: 'Why don't you try a falafel plate with fresh orange juice? It's very good today.'
examples.transliteration: In-naadile ibtasamet w iqtarahet: 'Leh ma btejarribi sahn falaafel ma' 'aseer burtu'aal fresh? Huwwe kteer tayyeb il-yom.'

examples.arabic: بنت عمتي الصغيرة ما بتحب القهوة هي شربت عصير برتقال وحكت عن فيديوهاتها الجديدة
examples.english: My little cousin (daughter of my paternal aunt) doesn't like coffee; she drank orange juice and talked about her new videos.
examples.transliteration: Bint 3ammti ṣ-ṣġeere ma btḥebb el qahwe hiyye sharbat 3aṣeer burtuqāl w ḥakat 3an videohat-ha l-jdeede.

examples.arabic: اكلنا كاتو طيب وشربنا عصير كتير
examples.english: We ate delicious cake and drank a lot of juice.
examples.transliteration: ʾAkalna kāto ṭayyib w sharibna ʿaṣīr ktīr.
